pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. A girl in a green sweater seated at a simple table with an unmarked wooden abacus and three small groups of red counting blocks. She moves one abacus bead and looks at the blocks attentively. All full figure, plain socks and furniture visible. Plain solid colors and clear shapes. No digits, letters, written equations or floating symbols. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
